title: The shared grounds import no sibling, and the bl_ and ql_ stages have no import cycle
goal: bl_base, ql_base, kg_base, bench_core and mon_base import no module of their own prefix, and no two bl_ or ql_ modules import each other; backlog.py and querylog.py run as before

clauses.clause: bl_base, ql_base, kg_base, bench_core and mon_base import no module of their own prefix
no two bl_ or ql_ modules import each other
backlog.py and querylog.py run as before

gates.question: ql_distill and ql_deliver import each other: distill builds the default push, deliver reads LOG_NAME, LOG_MAX_BYTES and spool_delivered. Breaking it keeps deliver above distill and has distill take a delivery factory that the one caller, the distill command of _tools/querylog.py, passes (ql_deliver.default_delivery); that file is outside this item's touches. Add it to the touches?
options: narrow the goal and leave the pair

gates.question: Where do the helpers that two modules of a cycle shared now live? worker_dirs and main_worker_dir (bl_land and bl_selfcheck) in bl_base; run (bl_base and bl_intake) as bl_base.run calling ql_base.run_cmd; public_url and bare_url (ql_store and ql_research) in ql_store; spool_claims (ql_learn and ql_distill) in ql_distill; Gate and bare_token (ql_apply and ql_research) in ql_learn
options: move each to the lower module, the old names still importable where callers use them
move each to the higher module
gates.recommendation: move each to the lower module, the old names still importable where callers use them

notes: operator request 2026-10-19 (housekeeping batch): AST scan 2026-10-19 (function-level imports included): bl_base -> bl_intake; cycles bl_base<->bl_intake, bl_land<->bl_selfcheck, ql_deliver<->ql_distill, ql_distill<->ql_learn, ql_apply<->ql_research, ql_research<->ql_store. Premise: the first check fails. Checks 1 (0-based) pass before the work on purpose: they pin behaviour that must stay (a gate, an eval, a guard test or a count that may not drop) beside the checks that fail until the work is done.
